name: Evidence Chain Format
description: Define the canonical evidence chain format: entries, links, hashes, timestamps, signatures. Every entry links to its predecessor.
purpose: Evidence chains are verifiable and append-only.
acceptanceCriteria: Evidence chain entries have a canonical format: timestamp, hash, predecessor hash, signature.
Every new entry links to the previous entry's hash.
Append-only: no entry can be removed without breaking the chain.
Chain integrity is verifiable by any party with the public key.
Evidence chains persist in PGlite as the authoritative store.
